versions.scplainer: workflow in scp 1.22.0; no separate package

seed_formula: seed + 100000 * zero-based grid index + one-based replicate

endpoint.power: all truly changed proteins; BH rejection plus sign agreement
endpoint.conditional_power: detected changed / testable changed; NA when none are testable; mean of defined replicates
endpoint.rejection_reporting: mean BH rejections and fraction of replicates with zero BH rejections
endpoint.realised_FDR: mean FDP among BH rejections, null proteins/rejections; zero for no rejections

instrument_time_source.section_anchor: The single-cell plexDIA sets were separated

instrument_time_definition: Actual occupied batches times cited method/gradient duration; excludes any unreported overhead
